raw:
The humid morning air clings to your tunic, smelling of damp moss and ancient, sun-warmed stone. Master Skywalker stands at the edge of the meditation balcony, his silhouette framed by the twin suns rising over the jungle canopy. He doesn’t turn when you ask about Kira or the pulsing weight you felt beneath the flagstones. Instead, he reaches out with a gloved hand, tracing a deep furrow in the weathered masonry.

"The Great Temple has many echoes," Luke says, his voice a low rasp. "The Massassi didn't just build with stone; they built with intent. There is a sub-level, sealed behind the western reliquary, where the air grows cold even at noon. I have forbidden the students from venturing there." 

He turns to look at you, his blue eyes kind but shadowed by a worry he cannot hide. "Kira has been searching for a strength she feels she lacks. She doesn't see that some doors only open when you stop trying to force them." He pauses, his gaze weighing heavily on your own burgeoning fear of power. "I cannot watch every shadow, and Kira will not listen to a Master she thinks is holding her back. But she might listen to a friend."

The realization twists in your gut: Luke isn't going to stop her. He’s asking you to.

---CHOICES---
1. Search the western reliquary for the sealed entrance Kira might have used. [Perception]
2. Confront Kira directly before the midday lessons begin. [Discipline]
3. Reach out through the Force to find Kira’s specific signature within the temple's depths. [Force:Sense]
